title: Tags
subtitle: Label customers, suppliers and products. A tag is a key (e.g. Color) with optional values (e.g. Red).
noBusinessDesc: You need to create or select a business before managing tags.
noStoreDesc: Select a store to manage tags.
noTagsDesc: Create your first tag to get started.
deleteKeyMessage: This permanently deletes the tag and all {count} of its value(s). This cannot be undone.
bulkDeleteMessage: This permanently deletes the selected tags (and all their values) and detaches them from any products using them. This cannot be undone.
existingHint: Existing tag — values you add below will be added to it.
keyHint: The label of the tag (e.g. Color, Size).
valueHintEdit: Click a value to rename it, or × to remove. Add new ones below.
valueHintNew: Optional. Add one or more values (e.g. Red, Blue).
keyTooLong: Key must be at most 100 characters.
descTooLong: Description must be at most 500 characters.
valueTooLong: Value must be at most 100 characters.
valueExistsOnTag: That value already exists on this tag.
valueInList: That value is already in the list.
checkingAffected: Checking how many products are affected…
safeToDelete: No products are using this — safe to delete.
usedByProducts: Used by {count} product(s). Deleting will detach it from them.

import.req: Key is required. Value and Description are optional.
import.commas: List several values in one cell, separated by commas.
import.prefix: A value may be prefixed with the Key; the prefix must match the row's Key or that value is skipped.
import.quotes: Wrap a value in double quotes to keep a comma or colon literal; double a " to include it.
import.afterQuote: After a closing quote, a word with no comma before it is dropped — add a comma or move it inside the quotes.
import.existingKey: A key that already exists gains the new values; the latest non-empty Description wins.
